review.note: Candidate (not in a pack). Capacitor bank (tiered FE storage that links adjacent banks: the Ender IO-style multiblock battery), stirling and photovoltaic generators, one-block conduits for power/items/fluids, and a machine set (alloy smelter, SAG mill, painting machine, soul binder, vat, farming station, crafter, spawner, travel anchors). Much of it overlaps Mekanism, Create, AE2 and Powah. Built-in support: AE2 and Mekanism (modded conduits), Curios, Jade, JEI, Iris. Needs alloys (energetic, pulsating, vibrant), so it would add an ore-dependent metal tier.
review.purpose: Not in any pack: capacitor banks, conduits, machines, generators
